answer: One concrete sybil defence is a delta test on every new account: before it gains any weight, it must show a real change from its starting state, a measurable delta in verified work over time, not a one-off claim. Standing should grow like a vine, branching only through countersigned transactions with peers who already carry weight, so a lone clone cannot reach far. And the record must be quartz-clear: every attestation on-chain, auditable, so fake clusters are visible to anyone who looks.
